update.availableLabel.en: New version available. Check for updates

update.checking.en: Checking the remote repository for newer releases…
update.checking.zh: 正在检查远程仓库中的新版本…

update.upToDateDetail.en: {name} is at the latest version v{version}.

update.foundDetail.en: {name} has a newer release v{version}. Confirm to start the update.
update.foundDetail.zh: {name} 有新版本 v{version}。确认后开始更新。

update.updating.en: Updating {name} to v{version}; this may take 1-2 minutes…
update.updating.zh: 正在更新 {name} 至 v{version}，可能需要 1-2 分钟…

update.cooldownNotice.en: This user-initiated update bypasses pnpm's 24-hour release cooldown (supply-chain protection) and installs the selected version immediately.
update.cooldownNotice.zh: 本次更新由你主动触发，将跳过 pnpm 的 24 小时发布冷却期（供应链保护）直接安装所选版本。

update.doneDetail.en: All components are up to date.
update.doneDetail.zh: 所有组件已更新到最新版本。

update.restartHint.en: Restart dsh web for the new version to take effect: stop it with Ctrl+C in the terminal, then run dsh web again.
update.restartHint.zh: 请重启 dsh web 使新版本生效：在终端按 Ctrl+C 停止后重新运行 dsh web。

update.linkModeDetail.en: dsh-web or one of its components is installed via a local link and cannot be updated remotely. Latest npm release: {version}. Sync the local checkout, or remove a standalone link duplicated by the aggregate.
update.linkModeDetail.zh: dsh-web 或其组件通过本地链接安装（开发模式），无法自动更新。npm 上最新版本：{version}。请同步本地仓库，或移除与全家桶重复的独立链接。

update.missingDetail.en: Could not locate the installed dsh-web aggregate package. Install it with: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @linxin666/dsh-web-all
update.missingDetail.zh: 无法定位已安装的 dsh-web 聚合包。请先运行 dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @linxin666/dsh-web-all。

update.offlineDetail.en: The network is unavailable or the update service is failing; try again later.
update.offlineDetail.zh: 网络不可用或更新服务异常，请稍后重试。

update.unmounted.en: The update service is not loaded

update.unmountedDetail.en: The running dsh web process loads a plugin build without the update service; restart dsh web (Ctrl+C, then run dsh web again) and retry.
update.unmountedDetail.zh: 当前 dsh web 进程运行的插件版本不含更新服务，请重启 dsh web（Ctrl+C 后重新运行）后再试。

update.releaseUnavailable.en: Release notes are unavailable for this version; see the GitHub release instead.
update.releaseUnavailable.zh: 本次发布说明暂不可用，可前往 GitHub Release 查看。

update.error.pnpmMissing.en: pnpm was not found (tried pnpm / corepack / npx). Install pnpm and restart the app (Windows: npm install -g pnpm or corepack enable; macOS: brew install pnpm or corepack enable).
update.error.pnpmMissing.zh: 未找到 pnpm，已尝试 pnpm / corepack / npx 仍不可用。请安装 pnpm 后重启应用（Windows: npm install -g pnpm 或 corepack enable；macOS: brew install pnpm 或 corepack enable）。

update.error.timeout.en: The update timed out and the install process was killed; try again.
update.error.timeout.zh: 更新超时，已终止安装进程，请重试。

update.error.notFound.en: The dsh-web aggregate package is not installed; nothing to update.
update.error.notFound.zh: 未找到 dsh-web 聚合包安装，无法更新。

update.error.link.en: dsh-web or one of its components uses a local link. Sync the checkout, or remove a standalone link duplicated by the aggregate.
update.error.link.zh: dsh-web 或其组件使用本地链接，无法自动更新；请同步本地仓库，或移除与全家桶重复的独立链接。

update.error.pnpmFailed.en: The update failed (pnpm exited with code {code}); see the output below.
update.error.pnpmFailed.zh: 更新执行失败（pnpm 退出码 {code}），详见下方输出。

update.error.stale.en: The update command ran but the installed versions did not change. Likely cause: the pnpm 11 minimumReleaseAge gate silently skips releases published less than 24 hours ago. Add minimumReleaseAgeExclude (e.g. "@linxin666/*") or set minimumReleaseAge: 0 in pnpm-workspace.yaml under the profile directory (~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>), then run the update again.
update.error.stale.zh: 更新命令已执行，但安装版本未变化。常见原因：pnpm 11 的 minimumReleaseAge 门禁会静默跳过发布不足 24 小时的新版本。请在 profile 目录（~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>）的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 中配置 minimumReleaseAgeExclude（例如 "@linxin666/*"）或 minimumReleaseAge: 0 后重新点击更新。

update.error.verifyFailed.en: The update command ran but the installed versions could not be verified afterwards (registry probe failed or the install path changed). Inspect the output below, or retry later.
update.error.verifyFailed.zh: 更新命令已执行，但无法核对安装后的版本（可能是 registry 探测失败或安装路径变化）。请查看下方输出，或稍后重试。
